title: Surrogate-Assisted Compact-Model Extraction for SKY130 CMOS at 77 K
abstract: arXiv:2611.21594v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cryogenic circuit design requires compact transistor models that reproduce measured low-temperature behavior and run in standard circuit simulators. We fit BSIM4 parameters to measured I-V curves of SkyWater 130 nm (SKY130) transistors at 77 K using a neural surrogate of NGSpice. The surrogate maps compact-model parameters and device geometry to the complete set of output and transfer characteristics. Extraction is a bounded least-squares search: a bank of NGSpice simulations supplies initial candidates, finite differences of the surrogate supply the local Jacobian, and NGSpice re-simulates the resulting cards before selection. On 18 measured geometries, we compare a search over seven card parameters with a search over 43 parameters selected by NGSpice sensitivity. translated_title: 77 K下SKY130 CMOS的代理辅助紧凑模型参数提取
translated_abstract: 低温电路设计需要能够重现实测低温行为、并可在标准电路仿真器中运行的紧凑晶体管模型。我们利用NGSpice的神经代理模型，将BSIM4参数拟合到SkyWater 130 nm（SKY130）晶体管在77 K下的实测I-V曲线。该代理模型将紧凑模型参数和器件几何尺寸映射到完整的输出特性与转移特性集合。参数提取是一个有界最小二乘搜索过程：一组NGSpice仿真提供初始候选解，代理模型的有限差分提供局部雅可比矩阵，并在最终选择之前由NGSpice对生成的模型卡片进行重新仿真验证。在18个实测几何尺寸上，我们比较了针对七个卡片参数的搜索与针对由NGSpice灵敏度分析选出的43个参数的搜索。相对于先前发布卡片经NGSpice重新仿真的结果，这两种搜索方法分别将样本内平均相对均方根误差（RRMS）降低了17%和26%。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于NGSpice神经代理模型的有界最小二乘参数提取方法，为77 K下SKY130 CMOS晶体管拟合BSIM4紧凑模型参数，将样本内平均相对均方根误差降低了17%至26%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bounded least-squares parameter extraction method based on a neural surrogate of NGSpice to fit BSIM4 compact-model parameters for SKY130 CMOS transistors at 77 K, reducing the in-sample mean RRMS error by 17% and 26% with searches over seven and forty-three parameters respectively.
